title: Header lines flow around a side-wrapped drawing with the body rule: a line that cannot sit beside it lands at the drawing's bottom and the body follows; a line that fits beside it leaves the body top alone
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf: Letter, 1in margins, header 36pt, Calibri 11, four header lines (36.05/49.49/62.93/76.37) and a 1.5pt wrapSquare picture at page y 80; control body glyph top 89.81; a 540pt rule across the column (page x 36) puts line four at 81.65 and the body at 94.85 (+5.04); a 100pt rule at the column's left edge leaves line four beside it at x 136 and the body at 89.81; the same 540pt rule anchored paragraph-relative at the same page y: 94.85; a 100pt rule in the middle (x 236-336): line four stays at x 72, body 89.81

cases.note: CASE01 full-width rule at page y 80: header line four lands at the rule bottom (81.65), body +5.04
CASE02 100pt rule at the column's left edge: line four flows beside it (x 136), body unmoved
CASE03 the full-width rule anchored paragraph-relative (44pt below the strip top = page y 80): same as CASE01
CASE04 100pt rule in the middle of the column: line four keeps the left gap (x 72), body unmoved
